articles.summary: SAN DIEGO [April 5, 2022] – Trestle Biotherapeutics announced today that is has been selected as a “Cool Company” by Connect San Diego, an organization that helps promote San Diego’s top startups for funding. The post Trestle named as one of CONNECT San Diego’s “Cool Companies” for 2022 first appeared on Trestle Biotherapeutics .
articles.title: Trestle named as one of CONNECT San Diego’s “Cool Companies” for 2022
